acceptance_rule: Gate 1-4 capital-allocation test on identical frozen windows: 90% active cash-feasible core plus 10% candidate must improve aggregate expected_value_score by more than 10% over 6.2057, improve aggregate PnL over USD 130,992.36, have no more than one material window regression, worsen max drawdown by no more than 0.5 percentage points, fund at least 20 pairs across at least two windows with survival at least 5%, preserve nonnegative cash and gross exposure no greater than candidate NAV. Passing is accepted default-off paper only because broker locate/availability is unpopulated; failure rolls back run.py pair wiring.

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: Risk-allocation pair-spread alpha: on the fixed 120 source dates, a stock simultaneously in the top four of the 20-name ORTEX costToBorrowNew cross-section and top four of the same-date Moomoo short-volume-ratio cross-section represents borrow-supported sell pressure; short the highest equal-weight rank-sum name and buy the lowest-stress same-cluster peer with strictly-prior 20-session return correlation at least 0.20, enter at the shared next-session open, exit five sessions later, and allocate exactly 10% from core to the cash-collateralized market-neutral sleeve. Fixed one new pair/day, maximum five concurrent pairs, USD 1,000 per leg, 10-session short-name cooldown, no short-proceeds reuse, 45bp round-trip cost per leg plus observed CTB accrual; default-off only.

main_failure_modes: displacing strong core lowers portfolio PnL
prediction.confidence_reason: The new source and pair-spread gate are genuinely independent and iBorrowDesk previously showed stressed names underperformed, but CTB-new is tightly clustered around 0.38%, the raw intersections concentrate in energy, and a 10% sleeve must displace an unusually strong cash-feasible core.

result.summary: After EV 5.4239 missed the strict 6.82627 threshold, after PnL 114688.52 fell below 130992.36, and all three canonical windows materially regressed.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The standalone spread lost money in every window before it was asked to replace core capital. Trade costs were meaningful but borrow cost was negligible, so the failure is the pressure-to-relative-return mapping, not a fee-model artifact.
post_run_reflection.alpha_interpretation: Dollar neutrality delivered near-zero SPY beta and improved drawdown, but diversification without positive standalone expectancy destroyed EV and PnL when funded from the strong core.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not sweep top-N, correlation floor/lookback, cluster membership, hold, cooldown, notional, cost, borrow accrual, direction, or 10% weight on the same ORTEX/Moomoo row surface; do not relabel it as a squeeze-long or another consensus filter.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A genuinely new gate shape or signal family, a sustainable same-day cross-sectional feed with materially more prospectively settled rows, or new PIT borrow/availability/utilization plus broker locate evidence. Threshold or response retuning alone is not valid.

calibration.surprise_note: Borrow cost was negligible; the raw long-short spread lost money in all three windows and core displacement dominated the portfolio loss.
